mainEntity.name: How can customer reviews and testimonials impact AEO for home service providers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer reviews and testimonials significantly impact AEO for home service providers by building trust and providing valuable content. Positive reviews, especially those with detailed descriptions of services rendered and keywords related to your business, can be parsed by answer engines to validate your expertise and reputation. High ratings and a consistent stream of positive feedback signal to search algorithms that your business is reliable and trustworthy. This can influence your visibility in local packs and answer boxes, as search engines often feature businesses with strong social proof when directly answering customer queries.
